projects.title: EcoNutri AI
projects.tagline: Cloud-Native Precision Agriculture & Soil Nutrient Diagnostics
projects.summary: Solar-powered IoT sensors deployed across Baramati agricultural fields transmit real-time N-P-K soil metrics. An AWS serverless pipeline analyzes nutrient deficiency and generates hyper-localized Marathi/English fertilizer schedules via Amazon Bedrock.

steps.title: IoT Field Sensors
steps.desc: Solar ESP32 nodes sample soil moisture, pH, and N-P-K in Baramati sugarcane & grape fields.

steps.title: AWS IoT Core
steps.desc: Secure MQTT ingestion channel with mutual X.509 device certificates and topic rule routing.

steps.title: AWS Lambda & DynamoDB
steps.desc: Serverless validation, time-series telemetry logging, and threshold anomaly detection.

steps.title: Amazon Bedrock (Claude 3.5)
steps.desc: Generative AI agronomist agent synthesizes soil data into conversational Marathi advisories.

steps.title: Amazon SNS & WhatsApp Gateway
steps.desc: Automated SMS/WhatsApp alerts delivered straight to the farmer's mobile handset.

projects.title: SkipShop AI
projects.tagline: Edge Computer Vision & Serverless Autonomous Retail Checkout
projects.summary: Frictionless checkout experience tailored for local grocery stores and college campus marts. Edge cameras track items with computer vision, synchronizing with AWS AppSync GraphQL for instant queue-free payment.

steps.title: Edge Camera Stream
steps.desc: Dual overhead high-fps RTSP cameras capture shopper basket item selection.

steps.title: Amazon Rekognition & SageMaker
steps.desc: Real-time object classification and bounding-box matching with campus retail SKUs.

steps.title: AWS AppSync (GraphQL)
steps.desc: Bi-directional WebSocket connection pushing live cart line items to the student's phone.

steps.title: DynamoDB & UPI Lambda
steps.desc: Atomic balance ledger updates and serverless payment webhooks.

projects.title: Skipline Go
projects.tagline: Event-Driven Campus Dining Queue & Pre-Ordering Engine
projects.summary: Built for the VPKBIET campus cafeteria to eliminate peak lunch rushes. Students pre-order and receive real-time prep status with serverless WebSocket broadcasts via AWS API Gateway and Amazon EventBridge.

steps.title: Next.js PWA Client
steps.desc: Progressive Web App with offline menu caching and instant biometric student login.

steps.title: WebSocket API Gateway
steps.desc: Persistent two-way connection for real-time kitchen order ticketing.

steps.title: Amazon EventBridge
steps.desc: Decoupled choreography routing orders from kitchen prep -> packing -> collection.

steps.title: DynamoDB Streams
steps.desc: Change data capture triggering instant push notifications upon order ready.

projects.title: CloudGuard Sentinel
projects.tagline: Automated AWS Free-Tier Cost Anomaly & Compliance Hunter
projects.summary: A student-designed AWS Lambda utility that audits student AWS accounts for orphaned EBS volumes, idle NAT gateways, and unencrypted S3 buckets, preventing surprise cloud bills.

steps.title: Daily CloudWatch Cron
steps.desc: Scheduled event triggers multi-region scanner Lambda function across ap-south-1.

steps.title: Cost & Resource APIs
steps.desc: Queries AWS Cost Explorer, EC2, and S3 APIs across student development accounts.

steps.title: Heuristic Anomaly Engine
steps.desc: Detects unattached volumes, idle load balancers, and public bucket ACLs.

steps.title: Discord Webhook Bot
steps.desc: Sends instant remediation alerts and cost forecasts to project Discord channels.

projects.title: CampusGrid Smart Energy
projects.summary: Real-time energy telemetry across VPKBIET academic buildings. Visualizes solar generation and HVAC load to reduce peak institutional electricity tariffs.

steps.title: Smart Energy Meters
steps.desc: Modbus RTU electricity meters in academic buildings 1, 2, and 3.

steps.title: AWS IoT Greengrass
steps.desc: Campus edge gateway aggregating high-frequency current and voltage signals.

steps.title: Amazon Timestream
steps.desc: Purpose-built time-series database ingesting 100,000 metrics daily.

steps.title: Amazon QuickSight
steps.desc: Executive dashboards visualizing live grid balance for faculty administration.

projects.title: PulseMed AI
projects.tagline: Multilingual Clinical Triage Assistant for Rural Clinics
projects.summary: Built for primary healthcare sub-centers in rural Pune. Uses Amazon Transcribe Medical and Bedrock to translate local Marathi voice symptom descriptions into structured clinical summaries.

steps.title: Mobile Audio Capture
steps.desc: Doctor or health worker records voice note in Marathi/Hindi dialect.

steps.title: Amazon Transcribe
steps.desc: Converts speech-to-text with specialized Indian regional phonetic models.

steps.title: AWS Step Functions
steps.desc: Orchestrates clinical entity extraction and symptom severity classification.

steps.title: Amazon Bedrock LLM
steps.desc: Formats symptoms into ICD-10 medical summary for referral hospitals.

projects.title: CloudForge CDK
projects.tagline: Production-Ready AWS CDK v2 Infrastructure Templates for Students
projects.summary: A curated open-source collection of reusable AWS CDK v2 constructs tailored for collegiate hackathons and student capstones: Serverless microservices, VPC peering, Aurora Serverless, and Bedrock RAG pipelines with one-command deployments.

steps.title: CLI Starter Tool
steps.desc: npx create-cloudforge-app bootstraps multi-stack CDK projects in seconds.

steps.title: Stack Synthesis
steps.desc: Synthesizes secure AWS CloudFormation templates with built-in cdk-nag security audits.

steps.title: Automated CI/CD
steps.desc: GitHub Actions workflow deploys into ephemeral preview environments.

projects.title: Bedrock Campus RAG
projects.tagline: Student Academic Handbook & Cloud Curriculum AI Knowledge Engine
projects.summary: Indexes VPKBIET academic regulations, course syllabi, and official AWS documentation into Amazon OpenSearch Serverless. Powers student inquiry with citation-grounded answers via Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

steps.title: Document Parsing
steps.desc: S3 ingestion bucket triggers Lambda text extraction and chunking.

steps.title: Titan Multimodal Embeddings
steps.desc: Amazon Titan Embeddings models generate 1536-dim semantic vectors.

steps.title: OpenSearch Vector Search
steps.desc: k-NN approximate nearest neighbor retrieval pulls top 5 relevant document chunks.

steps.title: Claude 3.5 Synthesis
steps.desc: Amazon Bedrock synthesizes strict grounded responses with source citations.

events.title: AWS Cloud Foundations Workshop (Demo)
events.speaker: Guest Cloud Architect (Demo Speaker)
events.speakerBio: Senior Solutions Architect & AWS Community Supporter
events.description: A hands-on introductory workshop covering the AWS Global Infrastructure, core compute (EC2, Lambda), storage (S3), and security best practices (IAM, MFA).
agenda: 11:15 AM — Hands-on Lab: Launching your first EC2 & S3 bucket
01:00 PM — IAM Least-Privilege & Cost Control Strategies
events.prerequisites: Laptop with web browser; no prior AWS account required (sandbox provided).

events.title: Serverless Architecture Hands-on Lab (Demo)
events.speaker: Student Tech Lead (Demo Speaker)
events.speakerBio: Cloud & Distributed Systems Enthusiast at VPKBIET
events.description: Construct an event-driven RESTful API from scratch using AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, and DynamoDB single-table design.
agenda: 02:45 PM — Live Coding: Lambda function handlers with Node.js
04:15 PM — Connecting DynamoDB & API Gateway routes
05:00 PM — Testing with Postman & Deploying with AWS CDK
events.prerequisites: Basic familiarity with JavaScript/Python and command-line interfaces.

events.title: Build with Generative AI & Amazon Bedrock (Demo)
events.speaker: AI Domain Team (Demo Facilitators)
events.speakerBio: VPKBIET Student Builders specializing in GenAI & NLP
events.description: A day-long builder sprint exploring foundation models on Amazon Bedrock. Teams prototype practical tools integrating RAG, prompt engineering, and conversational AI.
agenda: 09:00 AM — Bedrock API Overview & Model Access
10:00 AM — Hackathon Kickoff & Problem Statement Release
events.prerequisites: Team of 2–4 students with interest in AI, web development, or cloud architecture.
